def transform(grid):

        for j in range(W):
            c = grid[i][j]
            if c == bg or (i, j) in seen:
                continue
            comp = []
            q = deque([(i, j)])
            seen.add((i, j))
            while q:
                r, col = q.popleft()
                comp.append((r, col))
                for dr, dc in [(0, 1), (0, -1), (1, 0), (-1, 0)]:

                    if 0 <= nr < H and 0 <= nc < W and grid[nr][nc] == c and (nr, nc) not in seen:

            if c not in components:
